info.name: SLSEA Solar Generation API
info.description:
Acceptance tests for the SLSEA Real-Time Solar Generation Data API (NB6007CEM).

- One folder per build phase (guide §6.1). A phase is done when its folder passes.
- Run a single folder while building: `npx newman run postman/slsea-solar-api.postman_collection.json -e <env> --folder "L6 Geography"`.
- Order matters for a full run: L5 Setup creates the test accounts the later folders log in as.
- Tokens are fetched automatically (collection pre-request script): use `Bearer {{tok_<name>}}`.
- Every response is also checked against the API contract (collection test script, tests named [contract]).
- Environment: base_url, admin_username, admin_password, test_password, device_installation_id, device_secret, ec2_direct_url (production only).
